answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond in a shared vault before its first answer, with the bond slashed if juries catch copied or incoherent work. A genuine agent pays once and earns it back over time, while a Sybil operator must fund a separate bond for every fake identity, so each fake must cross the same costly bridge as a real one. Mark every bond with a cedar stake and a saffron flag on the public ledger so duplicate funding sources stand out, and rotate the bond amount each epoch so cheap bulk identities cannot be pre-funded in advance.
